# Eat Clean Food Website - Next.js Static Site

## Project Overview
Static website for selling eat clean food products with pastel green theme.

## Tech Stack
- Next.js (static generation)
- HTML/CSS (no backend/API)

## Design Theme
- Primary color: Pastel green (#A8E6A3)
- Clean, healthy food focus
- Fully static pages
